outcome.description: completed: the task goal is fully achieved. partial: some of it is done. blocked: could not proceed (permissions, missing input, environment). failed: attempted and did not work.

summary.description: What was done and found, written for the agent that delegated the task.

files_changed.description: Paths of files created, modified or deleted.

verification.description: What was actually run or checked to confirm the work, with its result; 'none' if nothing was verified.

remaining.description: Work left undone, open problems, or reasons for a non-completed outcome.
